name: application-mini-calendar-widget
title: Mini Calendar Widget
description: Compact, read-only month grid with event dots for at-a-glance schedules, sized to fit a dashboard sidebar or summary card without full date-picking interaction.
useWhen: Showing which days in the current month have events, without needing users to pick or navigate dates.
Space is limited — a dashboard sidebar or summary card widget rather than a full calendar page.
You want today highlighted and event days dotted, computed from real day numbers rather than hand-placed.
avoidWhen: Users need to select a date or navigate between months — use the full Calendar or DatePicker instead.
Events need per-day detail (titles, times) visible in the grid — use Event Calendar Grid instead.
You need a full year or multi-month view — this widget renders a single month.
responsiveBehavior: The widget is a fixed-width card (16rem) sized for sidebar placement; wrap it in a scroll container if the surrounding layout is narrower.
accessibility: Today and days with events carry visually hidden text ("(today)", "(has events)") in addition to the visual highlight/dot, since color and a small dot alone aren't conveyed to screen readers.
Weekday header letters are supplementary; full weekday names should be provided via a wrapping table or aria-label in a production integration if needed.
The highlighted "today" circle uses both a filled background and bold weight, not color alone.

variants.title: Mini calendar widget
variants.description: August 2026 month grid with today highlighted and five event-dotted days, on a light surface.
accessibility: Event dots are decorative (aria-hidden); the sr-only "(has events)" text carries the meaning.

variants.title: Mini calendar widget (Dark)
variants.description: The same August 2026 grid, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Today's highlighted background and event-dot colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
